title: C++: Persistent Stack
description: Implement a persistent (immutable) stack using shared_ptr nodes.

steps.title: Persistent Stack
steps.description: Create a PStack class that uses shared_ptr nodes. push creates a new stack sharing the old tail. Print demonstrates old versions remain valid.
hints: struct Node { int val; shared_ptr<Node> next; };
PStack push(int val) { return PStack(make_shared<Node>(val, head)); }
int peek() const { return head->val; } PStack pop() const { return PStack(head->next); }

verification.failureMessage: Old versions remain valid after push
